conclusion: The four named arms landed intact from origin/claude/riemann-hypothesis-research-ofds8s at 7043621 (1,717,013 bytes against ~58 MB on the branch; fkappa/, 56 MB of pickle and .ext_lock held back), and 29/29 acceptance checks pass, including an exact recomputation of RF-C003's promoted rational from the landed code and digit-for-digit agreement between the salvaged Weil arm and main's own Hunt #45 at (c, N) = (31, 60). Checking turned up a real defect: REPRODUCE.md's headline command for the campaign's only promoted claim named a symbol that never existed under that name or that signature, so a reader following the published recipe got an ImportError; that and two further broken references are fixed and pinned.
confidence: Lean hard on the mechanical half: inventory, exclusion, size, the lexical gate, reference resolution and the JSON gate counts are read out of the landed bytes by probe.py and rerun in one command. Lean hard on the (31, 60) figures, which are the one thing here corroborated by an independent route already on main. Do NOT lean on RF-C003's mathematics: probe.py runs that arm's own code and shares every assumption it makes, so it establishes reproducibility and document-code agreement and nothing about the transcription of the source paper's functional or the near-optimality of the rounded quartic. My first version of the DH check passed on a substring against the wrong file, which is a reminder that the confidence here is only as good as each check's stated definition; both halves are now pinned.

core_candidates.what: A salvage acceptance probe: given a source ref and a list of paths, assert the landed subtree matches the source tree file-for-file, carries no excluded path, stays under a size ceiling, passes the lexical gate, and resolves every repo-relative path its own markdown cites. Four of this hunt's twenty-nine checks are subject-specific; the rest are that generic pattern, and every cherry-pick from an abandoned branch needs them.
core_candidates.why_reusable: This tree has an accumulating population of unlanded agent branches, and the salvage sweep is a recurring operation. The dangling-reference check alone found a broken recipe for a promoted claim that had survived a campaign, an assessor and a sweep, and it is eight lines.
core_candidates.first_step: Extract the inventory / exclusion / size / lexical / cited-path-resolution block from hunts/r_f00e48/probe.py into a script taking (source_ref, landed_prefix, excluded_paths, size_ceiling), and run it against the next salvage before deciding whether it deserves to live in scripts/.

core_candidates.what: A repo-wide markdown reference linter: every repo-relative path cited in a .md file must exist, or sit under an explicitly marked NOT-LANDED / historical heading.
core_candidates.why_reusable: Three broken references in one 84-line reproduction page, one of them the entry point to the campaign's only promoted claim. A reproduction page that does not run is a credibility defect and is mechanically detectable.
core_candidates.first_step: Run the regex from probe.py's reproduce:paths_resolve check across all of docs/ and hunts/ and count the dangling references before deciding whether it earns a test.
